newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia says to supply NMT system to Russia.
newsitem.headline: Nokia says to supply NMT system to Russia.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it would deliver and install an analogue NMT 450 cellular system to AOZT Tele-North in Murmansk, Russia, but gave no value of the deal.
"The delivery will include a Nokia DX 200 MTX mobile switch, base stations and transmission equipment," Nokia said.
The deal would strengthen Nokia's "leading position" in the region, it said, adding it had already earlier made long-term frame agreements with other operators in north-western and western Russia.
Tele-North is a closed joint stock company between local Murmansk telecoms operator Murmanskelektrosvjyaz and St Petersburg-based holding company Telecominvest, Nokia said.
The new equipment to be supplied by Nokia will make Tele-North part of Russia's federal NMT 450 network, it said.
